from kohakutpu.application.kernels import lanes as LN
from kohakutpu.application.kernels import transpose as TP


def facts():
    rk, rg = TP.reverse_kernel(4096, ((64, 64), (2, -32)), 32, 2048, MACHINE.vc)
    pl = LN.plan(32, ((32, 1),), 0, ((32, 1),), 0, 32, False)
    lk, lg = LN.relayout_kernel(pl, MACHINE.vc)
    out = {}
    for name, k, g in (("reverse", rk, rg), ("lanes", lk, lg)):
        t = k.trace(g, machine=MACHINE)
        out[name] = {
            "type": type(k).__name__,
            "prefix": k.name.split("_")[0],
            "parts": len(k.name.split("_")),
            "built": k.source == "",
            "ports": sorted(k.ports),
            "traced": t.name == k.name,
        }
    return out
